Prompts

```
['create a distributed broadcast operation to send a tensor from one rank to all processes in a group', 'create a distributed all-reduce operation to combine tensor data across all processes with a specified reduction op', 'create a distributed all-gather operation to collect tensors from all ranks into a list on every process', 'create a distributed all-to-all operation to scatter input tensors and gather outputs across all ranks', 'create a distributed all-to-all single operation to split and scatter an input tensor across all ranks']
```

